set.name: 2025-26 Topps Chrome x Cactus Jack Basketball
set.note: Second NBA collaboration between Fanatics/Topps and Travis Scott (Cactus Jack). Streetball aesthetic — chain net and brick wall design DNA. 18 base parallels form one of the deepest rainbows in the hobby.

relatedSets: 2025-26 Topps Chrome x Cactus Jack Basketball NBA All-Star Game

_dataNotes: Hobby-only configuration: 4 cards per pack, 20 packs per box, 12 boxes per case.
18 base parallels form the rainbow. Numbered parallels: Gold /50, Orange /25, Black /10, Red /5, Red Mini-Diamond /5, Superfractor 1/1.
Two autograph subsets (Base Autographs BV-, Cactus Ink CI-) share the 4-parallel autograph rainbow: Orange/Black/Red/Superfractor.
Three common inserts (Utopia Highlights UH-, Jacked Up JU-, La Flame Legends LFL-) share an 8-parallel rainbow. Two rare inserts (Astrovision AST-, Cactus Mode CM-) are Superfractor-only.
Jacked Up mixes veterans, rookies, and retired legends. La Flame Legends is legends-only.
